researchExecution.explanation: This script prepares structured research plans. It does not independently access search engines, Google Trends, Search Console, or competitor websites.
researchExecution.nextRequirement: Connect an actual research source or research-capable service before recording findings or assigning evidence-based scores.

scoringMethod.scale: 0-5, or null when evidence is insufficient

problemSeverity.description: Evidence that the target user experiences a meaningful problem.

demandEvidence.description: Verified evidence of demand for a solution.

competitionOpportunity.description: Evidence of competitor weaknesses or an underserved need.

organicSearchOpportunity.description: Evidence that relevant searches could attract suitable users.

buildFeasibility.description: Practicality of building, testing, and maintaining the tool.

monetizationPotential.description: Evidence supporting a plausible business model.

operationalSustainability.description: Long-term affordability, reliability, privacy, and maintenance.

scoringMethod.weightedScoreFormula: Sum(score / 5 * criterion weight) for scored criteria only. A definitive total is permitted only when all criteria have sufficient evidence.
rules: Never invent evidence or numerical metrics.
Missing evidence must remain null, not zero.
Do not calculate a definitive weighted score when any criterion is unscored.
A high score does not override serious legal, security, or feasibility risks.
A completed script run does not mean market research was completed.
A BUILD decision requires evidence and a documented validation rationale.
